preconditions.description: The length of numbers a and b is between 2 and 10^5.
Number a is within the range [10^(n-1), 10^n).
Number b is within the range [10^(n-1), 10^n).
Numbers a and b have the same number of digits.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' if not possible_to_win else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to win the jackpot, print '-1'. Otherwise, proceed to the next conditions.
The first line of the output contains the minimal possible number of coins c the player has to spend.
There are min(c, 10^5) lines following the first line, each containing two integers d_i and s_i.

postconditions.expression: if possible_to_win: all(1 <= int(move.split()[0]) <= n - 1 for move in return_value.split('\n')[1:])
postconditions.description: Each d_i is between 1 and n - 1.

postconditions.expression: if possible_to_win: all(int(move.split()[1]) in [-1, 1] for move in return_value.split('\n')[1:])

postconditions.description: After applying the described operations, the number a is transformed into b.
